name: items
description: A list of items to display as tags.

params.name: label
params.description: The text label for the tag.

params.name: href
params.description: An optional URL for the tag item. If not provided, the tag will be rendered as a plain text item.

params.name: title
params.description: If an `href` is specified, this is an optional title attribute for the tag item.

params.name: selected
params.description: If `true`, highlight the tag as selected.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the tag item.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the tag item.

name: small
description: If `true`, reduce the font size and padding of the tag items.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the tags.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the tags.
